messages:
sam: FYI I opened a PR for the routing shim change that needs an architecture check before we merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9987
sam: linked RFC in the description but pushing here since we need explicit arch ack and a short canary plan. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2031
tess: Thanks — quick skim looks reasonable. arch @archibald can you take a look at the failure/fallback strategy?
archibald: will do, rough ETA 24h. two quick Qs: does this change alter shard affinity or just add a routing shim?
alex: it adds a shim + optional affinity header. default behavior unchanged, but we expose affinity for dedicated pools.
carla: adding notes: SLA impact minimal if fallback works, but we need to test cross-tenant failsafe (prefetch KV cache invalidation). can we add an integration test?
sam: yes will add integration test and e2e scenario for cache invalidation. planning a small canary (1% traffic) for 48h.
archibald: please add the canary timeline + rollback criteria in PR description. Also include perf numbers from local run (p95 token latency).
lisa: I ran a quick benchmark on a g4dn and p95 is +12ms on our baseline for the shim path. I'll paste results in the PR.
carla: also document the model-variant fallback mapping in the RFC — right now it's implicit. make it explicit so ops can reason about rollbacks.
sam: will update RFC and PR tonight. pinging @deploy-bot to reserve a release slot after arch ack.
deploy-bot: Release slot requested for PR #9987. Awaiting approvals and arch ack.
archibald: one small design note in the RFC comments about token cache TTLs; otherwise LGTM from architecture side once PR description updated with canary + rollback.
tess: thanks! once you've updated PR I can add code review and merge if no objections.
sam: updating now, should be done in ~2 hours. I'll @archibald again when done. :thumbsup:
